checks.name: actual workerd login, explicit refresh gate, bootstrap and retry keep original UUID and two private cookies
current refresh creates exactly one receipt and the old parent retry returns the same successor
expired access lease renews via direct parent while preserving current refresh generation
authority loss during an actual D1 batch rolls back family/session/receipt and retains cookies
lost receipt or corrupted operation marker cannot commit a partial real D1 rotation
local logout revokes its entire family despite stale mirror and preserves another device
global logout is atomic and late retry leaves a later login valid
verified-user D1 limiter stays effective when refresh token and edge IP change
cross-origin request is rejected before mutation and transport never exposes either token in JSON

realWorkerd.scope: Actual local workerd, D1 binding withSession, core/HTTP controller and shared D1 rate limit
realWorkerd.limits: Synthetic users/keys; not mounted, no hosted UI/legacy Supabase cookie adoption/provider/native primary authority or production changes

buildEvidence: Each of typecheck/scoped lint/workerd/Vite/prune returned exit0 in captured refresh-check pipeline; no deploy
limits: No browser manager/Safari, Supabase legacy-cookie adoption, native-primary authority, recovery/signup or complete Auth migration proof
